# Element criteria: data and content (C17 to C24, C41)

Extra checks for data display and content, on top of the eight gates. Source: `frontend/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md` §8.4. Where this file and the guide differ, the guide wins; where the guide and `frontend/DESIGN.md` differ, the product contract wins. Other groups: [structure and navigation](./element-criteria-structure.md), [actions and input](./element-criteria-actions.md), [layers, state and work](./element-criteria-layers.md).

Columns: Place · Semantics and markup · Copy · Colour · Red flags (duplicate or risk signals).

| ID | Element | Place | Semantics | Copy | Colour | Red flags |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C17 | List, list-detail | list left or top, detail right or below, selection kept | `listbox` or link list | item title equals detail title | selected: `surface.selected` | selection lost; detail repeats list data |
| C18 | Data table, TreeGrid | sticky header only with `scroll-padding-top` at least its height; row actions at row end; selection column first; supports the tasks the table serves (find rows, compare values, view or edit one row, act on rows; a read-only table needs the first two) | read-mostly `table` with `th scope` on every column and no data in `::before`; sorted column has `aria-sort`; editable cells use grid pattern (§5.6) | column title: noun plus unit once when every value shares it (per value only when units mix); basis once in header or caption; numbers end-aligned with their header; an empty value uses one mark that differs from an error mark and from 0 (§5.9) | status colour only with sign, icon or text; delta colour at 4.5:1 | column meaning differs per row; unit repeated in header and every value; a task above has no route; a column without a header cell (a rank drawn by a CSS counter); total row sorted away; links inside sortable headers; read and edit views that look different (§5.3); comparison split into cards (NN/g; a screen whose contract sets cards is the exception, §9.3) |
| C19 | Pagination, infinite list | consistent place above or below the table | `nav` with name, current `aria-current` | range and total ("1-25 / 1,204") | neutral | unknown total shown as exact |
| C20 | Badge, tag, chip | next to the value it describes | status is `span`; filter chip is `button` | noun or adjective | `status.*` meaning fixed; no decorative colour; two or more of colour, shape, symbol (§4.4) | same status in different colours; status badge looks like a button; one colour doing duty as action, status and decoration |
| C21 | KPI, summary, stats | above detail; with scope, period, refresh time | value, unit, basis as one group | number plus unit plus basis | value neutral; only change gets meaning colour | fake or unqueried value (0); disagrees with detail |
| C22 | Chart | title, legend, axis units together | `role="img"` plus summary or table alternative; tooltip values reachable by keyboard | axis and legend names; direct labels | colour-vision-safe palette (8 categories or fewer) plus shape | colour-only distinction; more than 8 category colours; a value that exists only in a tooltip |
| C23 | Image, video | only when informative | `alt` (empty if decorative), captions | alt states purpose | n/a | alt text on decoration; size not reserved |
| C24 | Label in shape or cell | centred with margin to edges | clipped labels reachable via `title` or detail | short | 4.5:1 against the fill | shrunk until unreadable; label overflows |
| C41 | Note or footnote marker | right after the value it qualifies; note text reachable | link to the note, named by what it is ("Note a"), not a bare "[u]" | same marker, same meaning | link colour | marker under 24 px beside another target; marker without a reachable note; one marker for several meanings |
